ai_text: That explains why you're feeling so affected. Close neighbors often become like extended family, so seeing them suffer can be deeply painful.

user_text: When I met her yesterday, she couldn't stop crying.
ai_text: That must have been very difficult to witness. Seeing a close friend cry can make their pain feel much more real and can leave us feeling helpless too.

user_text: My family and I stayed with them for several hours.
ai_text: That was a compassionate thing to do. During painful moments, having supportive people nearby can bring comfort, even when the situation itself cannot be changed.

user_text: We didn't return home until very late at night.

user_text: I still had work the next morning, so I couldn't get enough rest.
ai_text: That sounds incredibly tiring. You were carrying emotional stress while also trying to fulfill your responsibilities. It's important to give yourself permission to rest whenever you can because difficult experiences affect us more than we sometimes realize.

user_text: Even today, I keep thinking about what happened.
ai_text: That makes sense. When something painful happens to people we care about, our minds often keep returning to it because we're still processing the emotions. Be gentle with yourself. It's okay if you need some time before everything feels normal again.
